campbell.title: Campbell City Council — October 6, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council agenda for October 6, 2026, lists discussion of temporary legal services arrangements during the city attorney transition, along with compensation and working condition matters for certain unrepresented city employees. The agenda also includes a proposed market adjustment to the city manager's salary.
keyTopics: Temporary legal services arrangements during the city attorney transition
Compensation and working conditions for unrepresented confidential, classified management, and unclassified management employees
Market adjustment to the city manager's salary

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — October 7, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council's October 7, 2026, agenda listed routine items like meeting minutes, check registers, and a treasurer's report, alongside several notable items for consideration: a $2.5 million budget amendment for the Hakone Gardens Koi Pond renovation, a new no-parking zone on Chester Avenue, and a major discussion on choosing the city's long-term law enforcement provider. The agenda also included a review of animal care service options and a public hearing on annual updates to the city code.
keyTopics: Hakone Gardens Koi Pond Renovation budget amendment ($2.5 million)
Decision on long-term law enforcement provider, including a possible switch to Los Gatos Monte Sereno Police Department
No Parking Anytime zone proposed for part of Chester Avenue
Comparison of animal care service providers, including continuing with San Jose Animal Care and Services or switching vendors
Public hearing on annual City Code updates covering appeals procedures and commissioner qualifications

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — October 13, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council's October 13, 2026, agenda listed routine financial reports, several resolutions on completed public works projects, a residential electrification rebate funding item, and updated below-market-rate housing guidelines. The agenda also included a review of the Commission and Committee Handbook and an update on Ada's Café at the Community Center.
keyTopics: Treasurer's and investment reports for the quarters ending September 30, 2026, and June 30, 2026
Updated Conflict of Interest Code for staff and commissioners
Project completion resolutions for sanitary sewer spot repairs / CCTV inspections and the FY2024-25 Annual Streets Project
$78,000 budget appropriation for a residential electrification rebate program
Below Market Rate For-Sale and Rental Housing Guidelines, with a CEQA Section 15061(b)(3) exemption finding

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — October 20, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council's October 20, 2026, agenda listed routine business, including approval of minutes from two earlier October meetings and review of financial reports for August 2026. The agenda also included authorizations for the Town Manager to execute agreements, including an amendment with Foster and Foster, a three-year agreement, and a lease amendment.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the October 6, 2026, Town Council Special Meeting and regular meeting
August 2026 expenditure, revenue, and financial / investment reports
Accounts payable check registers and payroll report approval
First amendment with Foster and Foster
Lease amendment negotiation authorization

san-jose.title: San José City Council — October 20, 2026
san-jose.summary: The San José City Council's agenda for October 20, 2026, lists routine business such as approving minutes, excused absences, and several special-event sponsorships, alongside substantive items including a city planning work plan prioritization, a review of the Independent Police Auditor's 2025 year-end report, and several land-use hearings covering a general plan amendment, a site development permit appeal, and an environmental exemption appeal tied to a proposed data center. The agenda also includes the City Manager's annual report and a Civil Service Commission interview, which is scheduled to be heard last.
keyTopics: 2025 Independent Police Auditor Year End Report
Citywide Planning Work Plan Prioritization
GP26-002: early consideration of a privately initiated General Plan Amendment at 525 Race Street
Administrative hearings on appeals for 470 West San Carlos Street and a data center use at 300 Holger Way
2025-2026 City Manager's Annual Report

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — October 20, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The agenda for this Mountain View City Council meeting lists a single study session: interviews with applicants for the Environmental Planning Commission. The remainder of the posted material consists of standard procedural and legal notices rather than substantive agenda items.
keyTopics: Study session: Council interviews of candidates applying for the Environmental Planning Commission

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — October 6, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council's October 6, 2026, agenda includes several routine approvals, a public hearing on a new water conservation rule banning potable water use on nonfunctional turf, and discussion of a proposed ordinance to retain service workers. The agenda also lists recognitions, informational reports, and other business items for the council to consider.
keyTopics: Public hearing on an ordinance implementing AB 1572 to prohibit potable water irrigation of nonfunctional turf
Discussion and possible action to introduce a Service Worker Retention Ordinance
Approval of public art for the Lakewood Park renovation
Amendment to a WSP USA Inc. contract for environmental consulting at the SMaRT Station and Sunnyvale Landfill, increasing funding and extending the term through 2028
Authorization to negotiate a PG&E easement over part of the Clean Water Facility (former Water Pollution Control Plant)

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — October 20, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council's agenda for October 20, 2026, includes a proposal for leasing the city-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard, a public hearing on financing for The RISE Block 5 Apartments project, and routine items like contracts, grant acceptance, and the City Manager's employment agreement. Several ceremonial recognitions are also listed, including Domestic Violence Awareness Month and National First Responders Day.
keyTopics: Proposed approach for leasing the city-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard
Public hearing (TEFRA) and proposed approval of conduit financing for The RISE Block 5 Apartments project
Grant acceptance and design services agreement with Biggs Cardoza Associates for the McClellan Road Bridge Project
Proposed amendment to City Manager Tina Kapoor's employment agreement and changes to appointed employees' compensation program
Year One update on the FY 2025-2027 City Work Program and Q1 FY 2026-27 update

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara Neighborhood-University Relations Committee — October 19, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara Neighborhood University Relations Committee has a special meeting agenda for October 19, 2026, covering a discussion of neighborhood nuisance issues tied to private property leases in the Old Quad neighborhood, plus updates from city and university representatives. The agenda also includes routine items like approving prior meeting minutes and setting the 2027 meeting calendar.
keyTopics: Discussion of neighborhood nuisance topics in private property leases, with possible direction to staff on communicating the Committee's input to property owners in the Old Quad neighborhood
Updates from the Community Development Department, Santa Clara University, and the Police Department
Approval of NURC meeting minutes from May 18, 2026
Setting the 2027 Neighborhood University Relations Committee meeting calendar

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council's September 15, 2026, agenda listed several financial and infrastructure items, including a federal housing grant plan, a review of the red light camera program, and a look at the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The agenda also included resolutions related to the city's former Redevelopment Agency, including a bond refinancing matter.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency board
Resolution authorizing sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Architectural Review Board — October 15, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Architectural Review Board's agenda for October 15, 2026, includes a public hearing on a proposal by AT&T to add new wireless communication equipment to existing city-owned utility poles near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue. The request covers two wireless facilities, including new antennas, radio equipment, and seven-foot pole extensions, located in the public right-of-way rather than on private property.
keyTopics: AT&T request to collocate wireless antennas, remote radio units, and pole extensions on city-owned utility poles near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue
Project classified as CEQA-exempt under the 'Existing Facilities' exemption (Guideline Section 15301)
